horoscope: Tensions tend to rise today, dear Aries. The desire for more attention to your personal interests is strong, but you also want to take care of business. It can be challenging to be productive without succumbing to distractions, and there can be a tendency to take things very personally. Interactions can be loaded. Somebody may be using a rough or insensitive approach, or on the opposite end, an approach that isn't straightforward enough, and a disconnect ensues. Differences today ideally lead to new insights and fine-tuning that improves matters. For now, there can be some unrest. Boredom may even lead to a conflict or clash. Aim to observe rather than jump into action, and to avoid wasting not only time but energy and happiness. It can be difficult to say "no" to others and to things you want now, but this, too, will pass.

Today's transits can stir up dissatisfaction in spots, dear Taurus. Feelings can run hot and cold, and timing can be off on a social level temporarily. Boundaries might be pushed, and possessiveness or competitiveness can be themes. It's best not to mix emotions and practical matters right now with a Sun-Venus-Mars conflict. It may be a good strategy to give others the benefit of the doubt and to avoid jumping into or out of something too quickly. As well, you may want to keep an eye on spending since impatient Mars is under strain and is currently transiting your money sector. True desires stick around and don’t have such a short shelf life or timetable.

Today's transits tend to highlight areas of dissatisfaction or disagreement, dear Gemini. Since impulsive Mars is currently in your sign, it can affect you more than others, and others might be pushing your buttons as it clashes with Venus and the Sun. Instead, if you're feeling a little on edge or unsatisfied, the temptation to rile others up can come on. Waiting on an outcome or agreement with high expectations can put undue pressure on your life. Keep yourself busy, and aim to detach yourself just enough to stay calm and work things out. However, pay attention to what's emerging from within since you may revisit unresolved problems later.

Emotional energy is a little bit tense today, dear Cancer, and it may be best to avoid undue stress. A Venus-Mars square can stir up some frustrations. You're not on the same wavelength as someone, making it tricky to interact in healthy ways. You may later regret hasty actions or words, particularly in love relationships. It's probably best to wait out making important decisions since it's hard to be objective right now. These temperamental conditions can seem random, but they could also push problems that have already been brewing to the surface, bringing issues to light. Quicker resolutions become possible. Consider that sudden desires may mask the real root of a problem today, and aim to look deeper.

Today's transits are a little tricky, dear Leo, with tensions more prominent than usual. You might feel pressure to do something different or seek out something new, but without a clear direction, you can feel restless. Clashes are possible if impatience takes over. Although today's conflicts between the Sun, Venus, and Mars can be challenging, it's better to get in touch with your true desires so that restlessness doesn't lead you astray. Desires that come on suddenly and insistently are more likely to arise from boredom than true need or want under this influence. It stirs up dissatisfaction with current conditions, which could lead to a creative solution. Avoid making too-quick decisions and choices if possible.

You are in demand and getting noticed, dear Virgo, which tends to conflict with today's drives. You're creative enough to make everything work, but do watch for a tendency to appease and agree just so you can make a problem go away, as it's likely to be more than you bargained for. We're heading toward a Venus-Mars square that brings some impatient, brusque, or demanding energy. Touchy situations and people can be challenging to navigate. Try not to burn yourself out by pushing too hard or expecting instant results. Aim not to talk ahead of yourself or jump into action too quickly based solely on momentary feelings and impulses. Rising above conflicts is possible with some patience. Remind yourself that desires coming on suddenly today may not be a true reflection of what you want or need. Avoid impulsive or dramatic moves that won't serve you well in the long term.

Today's transits can generate some impatience, dear Libra, and they can highlight any discontent that's been working under the surface. You could become frustrated with someone on an idea or belief, especially if they seem to be shooting you down or not catching on to what you intend to say. Listening skills are subpar with these influences, and taking personal offense at intellectual disagreements can be an issue. You may want to escape but can't settle on how to do so. A tense atmosphere can make looking past small problems and challenges difficult temporarily. If you find yourself competing with someone over whose needs and desires should be paramount, it might be better to pull yourself out of it.

With today's transits, dear Scorpio, there can be inner conflicts to deal with or clashes with someone in your life. These influences can stir up dissatisfaction. A situation can leave you feeling unappreciated or put upon, and you might end up annoyed. Feelings are complicated, and whether you want to keep things light or go deep can be hard to know at the moment. There can be competitive energy at play in your relationships. Issues of how someone approaches you can be irritating, and people can be brusque or impatient, stepping on your feelings in the process. You may decide to give a special project special attention and compartmentalize, which could save your good humor.

Today's somewhat tense aspects can stir up or highlight discontent, dear Sagittarius, or a disagreement can ensue. Ideally, unrest motivates you to make improvements. Reactions can be quick, and people may be working on a short fuse. While there can be a temperamental or competitive tone with these influences, you're gaining deeper insight into your work, goals, or ambitions through a bit of trial and error. As much as you may want to take action, listening and observing are more likely to serve you well. Instead, you might choose to adjust your approach to minimize friction and misunderstanding or let the conflict happen, just in case it takes you somewhere good! People may not completely know what they want, but may be focusing on something they don't have that they think is the answer to their restlessness.

The Moon spends much of the day in your sign, dear Capricorn, and then moves onto your resources sector. While this move often evens out your mood, today's transits can stir up areas of dissatisfaction. Be protective of information or feelings that you typically want to keep quiet, as there is an impulsive tendency that could be cause for later regret. Even so, friction today can lead to new insights and a better understanding of yourself and others. Venus is currently transiting your adventure and spirit sector, inspiring your interest in non-routine experiences and an enlightened view of your life. On the other hand, Mars is transiting your work sector and encouraging you to get the job done or attend to your duties. You can manage both, but integrating these things can seem especially challenging just for now. Timing can be just a little off.

There can be some tensions in interpersonal relationships today, dear Aquarius. The Sun is currently transiting your partnership sector, which is one of the most companionable transits. It's a time when you enjoy balancing give and take, and also when you tend to weigh up pros and cons. You're inclined to want to keep the peace. Venus in your solar chart, however, is finding pleasure in digging deeper into projects and relationships, and would rather not keep up appearances if it means ignoring the more profound issues. Today, these bodies clash, and you can be giving off some mixed signals to others. The signals may be just as jumbled on the inside! However, the vague discontent you may feel as a result of all of this is temporary, and from it, you may very well discover new ideas or interests. With Venus heading into a square with Mars as the day advances, unrest can continue, and while it can certainly be informative, it can also be frustrating! Sudden desires and urges deserve a second look, as they're unlikely to address genuine needs. People are impulsive and more disagreeable right now. Tricky areas tend to involve the sharing of money or responsibilities. While frustrations may have been building for some time, impatience to handle matters can overcome you today. Aim to entertain new ideas and perspectives but wait until today's tensions subside before drawing firm conclusions.

Today's transits are a little tense in spots, dear Pisces, or they highlight unrest that's been working under the surface. Areas of discontent seem more pronounced, and you can experience contradictory feelings and desires. There can be tensions, unrest, and perhaps emotional fireworks, particularly in family relationships and partnerships. It's important to remember to seek harmony and balance in these interactions, as this will bring reassurance and focus, but it may take some time to realize. You may be dealing with impatience or what seems to be bad timing temporarily. You could feel a bit lost as boundaries between your feelings and the outside world blur, and you may feel overwhelmed by others' emotions or elements of the past that haven't been put to rest. However, from these experiences, new insight emerges. Save important ideas or topics for an easier, more flowing time if possible.
